verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The cart API reference pages are markdown docs, llms.txt and the .md doc probes are documentation indexes, and the MCP server's OAuth metadata is not an API specification. These are adjacent artifacts, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
